related.title: DNS 階層：共用 referral 與快取查詢量
related.titleEn: DNS hierarchy: shared referrals and cache query counts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受守恆與逐流一致；不能將完美合成分布宣稱為所有流量的平衡保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecmp-flows.csv、桶負載圖及重新映射影響清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require conservation and per-flow consistency; perfect synthetic balance is not a guarantee for all traffic. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ecmp-flows.csv, bucket-load plots and a remapping-impact list.
related.difference: 建立name→zone→TLD關聯表，僅使用example保留名稱，逐次記錄cache hit/miss。
related.differenceEn: Build name-to-zone-to-TLD mappings using reserved example names and log each cache hit/miss.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
ECMP可按流雜湊分配；流數均勻不代表位元組均勻，重新映射也會影響既有流。
教學基準：40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean；對照：25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

遞迴解析可重用referral快取；權威查詢量取決於名稱、區域與快取狀態。
教學基準：5+10+100 = 115 queries；對照：100*3 = 300 queries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
ECMP can hash by flow; equal flow counts do not imply equal bytes, and remapping affects established flows.
Teaching baseline: 40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean; comparison: 25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Recursive resolution can reuse referral caches; authoritative query count depends on names, zones and cache state.
Teaching baseline: 5+10+100 = 115 queries; comparison: 100*3 = 300 queries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Serve Stale DNS: resilience versus data age
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受守恆與逐流一致；不能將完美合成分布宣稱為所有流量的平衡保證。 交接時須能核對：交付 ecmp-flows.csv、桶負載圖及重新映射影響清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Require conservation and per-flow consistency; perfect synthetic balance is not a guarantee for all traffic. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver ecmp-flows.csv, bucket-load plots and a remapping-impact list.
related.difference: 記錄原到期、stale截止、刷新嘗試與回覆來源，不能只保存新的小TTL。
related.differenceEn: Record original expiry, stale deadline, refresh attempts and response provenance, not only a new short TTL.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
ECMP可按流雜湊分配；流數均勻不代表位元組均勻，重新映射也會影響既有流。
教學基準：40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean；對照：25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Serve-stale允許特定失敗情境暫用過期資料；返回TTL與原始資料年齡需分開理解。
教學基準：300+600-700 = 200 s；對照：300+600-950 = -50 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Teaching baseline: 40/(100/4) = 1.6 peak/mean; comparison: 25/(100/4) = 1 peak/mean. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Serve-stale can temporarily use expired data in defined failure cases; response TTL and original data age differ.
Teaching baseline: 300+600-700 = 200 s; comparison: 300+600-950 = -50 s. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
